001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop;
002
003/**
004 * The actions about player and shop
005 */
006public enum ShopAction {
007  // buy = trading create = creating shop cancelled = stopped
008  PURCHASE_BUY,
009  PURCHASE_SELL,
010  CREATE_SELL,
011  CREATE_BUY,
012  CANCELLED;
013
014  public boolean isCreating() {
015
016    return this == CREATE_SELL || this == CREATE_BUY;
017  }
018
019  public boolean isTrading() {
020
021    return this == PURCHASE_BUY || this == PURCHASE_SELL;
022  }
023}
